MindSync is a 100% offline, privacy-first AI assistant. Your documents, photos, and chat conversations never leave your device. All intelligence is processed locally on your phone\'s hardware without subscription fees or server tracking.

MindSync offers two on-device AI tiers tailored to your phone:

• ⚡ MindSync Lite (0.5B, ~398 MB): Fast, lightweight, and battery-friendly. Ideal for budget phones with 2GB–3GB RAM for quick summaries, replies, and light tasks.

• 🚀 MindSync Pro (1.5B, ~986 MB): High-intelligence reasoning model for phones with 4GB–6GB+ RAM. Delivers deeper reasoning, structured document drafting, and nuanced conversations.

You can switch tiers anytime from the Home screen or below.

• 📷 Offline Neural OCR: Tap the scanner icon in Document Refiner or Chat to photograph or select physical documents, receipts, or notes. Text is extracted instantly without the internet.\n\n• 🔊 Offline Voice Read-Aloud: Tap the speaker icon on any AI result or chat bubble to listen to the text read aloud using your phone\'s offline neural speech synthesizer.
Why do I need a one-time download?
The download contains the neural weights of the AI model. Once stored on your phone, MindSync works 100% offline — even in Airplane Mode or off-grid.
Does any data leave my device?
Never. Unlike cloud-based AI apps (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude), MindSync has no backend servers. All computation happens locally in your device\'s memory.
How do I free up storage space?
Tap the Model Badge on the Home screen or use the Model Manager below to delete any model you are not currently using.
